query: Z-Image-Turbo Text to Image template wires ConditioningZeroOut into the negative KSampler input; at CFG above 1 this produces distorted output, while an empty CLIP Text Encode node gives cleaner results.

desired.outcome: Commenter lin-bot23 says Z-Image-Turbo expects CFG=1 and takes no negative prompt - distortion comes from high CFG, not the node; use the Z-Image template if negative prompting is needed (https://github.com/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image). OP (FrizzSoft) disputed, arguing empty CLIP Text Encode behaves better at CFG~1.5. No maintainer ruling or template change confirmed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
